name: healthy_body_exports
why: The term of comparison: a box extruded and nothing else. A single solid body, closed, without defects -- and the operation must say so plainly. Without this case, «I would not export it like this» on a broken part would not tell a check that works from one that refuses everything.

expect._why_one: «Check() says ONE on a sound body»: it is half of the trap. The other half is the line below.

expect._why_zero: «Check2() says ZERO on the same sound body». Two opposite conventions in the same interface: whoever swaps one gets a result that is consistent, stable and upside down. These two numbers are here on purpose, because the day a version of SOLIDWORKS changes them it will be seen from here and not from a verdict turned the wrong way round.

includes: as geometry it can be exported

expect.why: the limit is declared at every call, not once in the description: whoever reads the answer may never have read the catalogue.
